info.title: MonsiTools Calculation API
info.description: Send a calculator's inputs, get its result back as JSON. Premium accounts, 60 requests per minute. Authenticate with an API key from Dashboard > API access (Authorization: Bearer mt_live_...). Tools and their input ids: /api-tools.json. Every call made with your account is counted in its usage, shown on the dashboard.

post.description: Evaluates one math-mode calculator. Every input the tool declares is required; a missing one is an error rather than a silent zero.

400.description: Malformed body, no slug, or missing inputs.

404.description: No such tool, or not available through the API.

422.description: The inputs could not be calculated (for example, not numbers).

429.description: More than 60 requests in a minute.

get.description: Requires a signed-in session token (the dashboard uses this).
